create_FunctionGemmaToolParser: create a FunctionGemmaToolParser instance with a tokenizer to parse function calls from the FunctionGemma model
extract_tool_calls: extract tool calls from a FunctionGemma model output string using regex patterns
extract_tool_calls_streaming: extract streaming tool calls from incremental model output with delta text and token ids
parse_arguments: parse a FunctionGemma argument string with <escape> delimiters into a dictionary
adjust_request: adjust a ChatCompletionRequest or ResponsesRequest to disable special token skipping for tool calls
